digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The CM-CoE backlog and Sprint 19 path closed today, while Amazon Connect remains the clearest live risk: Salesforce escalated the support case to its highest tier and the team is still narrowing a likely configuration issue. Nine items carry forward, and Tuesday has two significant meeting conflicts to resolve.

items.label: Set the CM-CoE backlog and Sprint 19 path
items.detail: The backlog and Sprint 19 planning follow-up was marked complete today.

items.label: Set Amazon Connect coverage and the revised Denver path
items.detail: Salesforce has escalated the support case to its highest tier. The team is still narrowing whether the issue sits in Amazon Connect or Service Cloud Voice, with routing profiles, queue assignments, permissions, and agent-state sync among the likely causes. Confirm the owner, resolution path, and Denver go/no-go posture.

items.label: Choose the Attorney Review launch and coverage plan
items.detail: The EPMO intake was created today, and Tuesday now has working sessions for the BD process and the Salt Lake City opening. Confirm attorney coverage and whether rollout remains October 17 or moves to October 19.

items.label: Record and communicate the RFE MHE hold
items.detail: The project remains paused while Legal guidance and historical data are reviewed, and the September 30 target no longer applies. Document the review owners, the trigger for resuming planning, and the effect on scope and timing.

items.label: Confirm all five team self-reviews with HR
items.detail: Jean told HR that the team had completed the self-reviews, but a later HR message still listed Laura and Mar. Confirm all five submissions are recorded as complete.

items.label: Prioritize the Proactive Payday Notification intake
items.detail: The request was routed to the CM-CoE today. Confirm its priority, scope, and next owner so the CFO-backed intake can move forward.

items.label: Connect with Amy on Incident Response communications
items.detail: Confirm the Bucket 6 notification trigger, communication owner, and remaining Incident Response Guide inputs with Amy.

items.label: Share the new legal-guidance protocol with the remaining PMs
items.detail: The Legal Request Tool went live today and Jean provided feedback on the launch email. Brief the remaining PMs on when to include Leo, Raquel, or Cristian and how to distinguish required legal guidance from recommendations.

items.label: Clarify the held Quality-routing deadline
items.detail: Send the interim status, revised decision point, and communication owner while the work waits for the new Phase 1 matter-plan structure.

items.label: Plan the newly launched downward reviews
items.detail: The review cycle is open with an October 15 deadline. Check the assigned reviews and reserve writing time.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Use the deployment checkpoint to confirm the escalated support path and remaining configuration work.

items.label: 11:00-11:30 AM - Close Case scoping overlaps the EPMO slides block
items.detail: Choose coverage for the scoping call or move the slides focus time before the 11:30 AM Jhara 1:1.

items.label: 2:00 PM - Three-way meeting conflict
items.detail: CM-CoE Court Projects Review, the Attorney Review BD working session, and the EPMO leadership catch-up begin together. Assign coverage and define the decisions each readout must capture.

items.label: 4:00 PM - SLC workflow session overlaps the CSC portfolio review
items.detail: Choose coverage so the Attorney Review opening plan and the initial CSC portfolio review both receive a clear owner and handoff.
